Deterministic SDDK workflow tooling — First-class commands: status, plan, run, ship, recover

Usage: sddk <COMMAND>

Commands:
  version       Show the resolved framework version for the current directory
  project       Resolve deterministic project and workspace identity
  adopt         Plan, apply, inspect, or repair project adoption
  lint          Validate repository contracts and generated workflow documentation
  generate      Generate deterministic repository documentation
  cycle         Plan and apply workflow cycles under the local authority
  ledger        Verify the causal ledger and list its events
  capability    Plan and execute typed capabilities under the default-deny policy
  git           Run typed local Git operations with verified postconditions
  artifact      Store and verify content-addressed artifacts
  permission    Check agent phase and capability permissions
  validate      Validate structured results against canonical schemas
  agent-result  Convert legacy agent output into structured results
  release       Plan and apply local Git releases or optional forge integrations
  vault         Index, validate, search, and export knowledge vaults
  knowledge     Resolve the canonical knowledge vault path and profile
  dev           Developer tooling: doctor, gates, and atomic install/verify
  pack          Validate declarative pack manifests
  graph         Query, inspect, and rebuild the reactive knowledge graph
  metrics       Record, aggregate, and tune cycle telemetry metrics
  analytics     Report, trend, and bottleneck analytics from cycle metrics
  telemetry     Central telemetry control plane (cross-project ingest, aggregates, dashboard)
  uat           UAT (User Acceptance Testing): data-driven YAML plans rendered to self-contained HTML dashboards, with human-in-the-loop validation
  approval      Manage human approval decisions for governed capabilities
  rules         Architecture-rule registry: evaluate rules against baseline JSON (SDDK2-003)
  stale         Staleness and impact queries over the reactive graph (SPEC-012)
  fork          Fork, replay, diff and promote controlled experiments (SPEC-009)
  explore       Render task-specific views over the reactive graph (SPEC-013)
  completion    Generate or install shell completion scripts
  debt          Debt management: report generation, INC listing, INC backfill, gate evaluation
  status        Show the current cycle snapshot and lease. Delegates to `cycle status`
  plan          Plan a new cycle from a goal (DEPRECATED: use `sddk plan workitem` instead)
  run           Execute a capability. Delegates to `capability run`
  ship          Plan a release (dry-run). Delegates to `release plan --dry-run`
  recover       Rebuild a cycle from ledger events (dry-run). Delegates to `cycle rebuild --dry-run`
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
